job.question: What minimum qualifications must an audit firm meet in the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services?
job.expected_facts: (1) Professional public accounting firm organized at least on a regional basis providing audit and attest services; (2) within the last five years, at least five audits of defined benefit pension plans with assets over $2 billion; (3) experience auditing equity securities (domestic and foreign), fixed income, real estate, alternative investments, commodities and securities lending; (4) an established office in the United States; (5) independent, licensed by and in good standing with California under the Accountancy Act; (6) Engagement Partner (and signing partner) located in the U.S. with at least 10 years of public accounting experience including DB pension plan audits, California-licensed CPA; (7) Engagement Manager located in the U.S. with at least 5 years of public accounting experience including DB plan audits, CPA licensed in a U.S. state; (8) On-Site Audit Supervisor located in the U.S. with at least 3 years of auditing experience including DB plan audits, CPA licensed in a U.S. state; (9) Engagement Manager and Supervisor available for consultations and in-person meetings throughout the year.
job.acceptance: Accept a faithful summary of the nine requirements. Do not impose desirable two audits of >$3bn plans or a California license for manager/supervisor as minimums; a U.S.-state license suffices for those roles.

reviews.reason: The document is a Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) audit-services RFP, not a KCERA RFP. Its minimum qualifications differ and it does not explicitly restate KCERA’s requirements.
quotes: Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions Internal Audit Section
The City of Los Angeles Fire & Police Pensions (“LAFPP” or the “Plan”) is seeking proposals from qualified certified public accounting firms
1.4.1 The firm must have key personnel with at least five years of experience auditing governmental agencies and/or public pension funds.
1.4.2 The Engagement Partner must be licensed to practice in the State of California as a Certified Public Accountant
